changes: Bound equality category/kind values expose selective predicates to the planner.
A category-leading partial index covers located records.
Materialized category/bounding candidates precede exact spheroidal ST_DWithin and ST_Distance.
Full canonical JSON is fetched only for the sorted paginated winners.
Published status count sums immutable manifest totals validated inside atomic import publication.
semantics: Geography radius remains exact metres with spheroidal checks; PostGIS own _ST_Expand GiST bounding predicate only narrows candidates. Limits, ordering, snapshots and cursor identity are unchanged. No geometry approximation or skipped category is introduced.

tests.statement: Boundary test compares indexed results and distances with direct exact ST_DWithin, including inside/edge/outside points and paging. Place anchor checked ST_Covers against a polygon with a hole.
